RuntimeMetrics.Title: Runtime Metrics
RuntimeMetrics.Description: Inspect process CPU, memory, ThreadPool and GC evidence in a bounded sample window.

Page.Subtitle: See the runtime at work. Compare current measurements with the observations retained by this host.

Messages.RefreshFailed: The view could not be refreshed.
Messages.Retained: The last successful view is retained below. Its capture time has not advanced.
Messages.NoSnapshot: There is no successful view to display yet.

Trend.Title: The recent shape of this process
Trend.Scope: Separate scales, actual sample times. Older observations leave this window when capacity is reached.
Trend.CpuChart: Process CPU history, percent, time axis
Trend.MemoryChart: Working-set history, decimal megabytes, time axis

Plot.Description: Values follow actual sample times. Browse retained samples for exact measurements.
Plot.KeyboardHelp: Arrow keys or Home/End select a sample. Escape clears the preview.
Plot.Idle: Hover a sample or browse below.
Plot.Evicted: The selected sample left this window. Showing the oldest retained sample.
Plot.Gaps: {0} samples cannot be plotted; their recorded values remain available.

Trend.NoSelection: Select CPU or working set above to show its history. All samples remain available below.
Trend.NoRetention: This host retains zero samples. Collection can continue, but this view cannot show a latest retained point or a trend.
Trend.SingleRetention: This host retains one sample. The latest values are available, but a line needs at least two retained observations.
Trend.SingleWaiting: A second retained observation will make the time series available.
Trend.Waiting: The collector has not provided retained samples to this view yet. Refresh to read the current window.
Trend.MeasurementHelp: MB uses 1,000,000 bytes. Snapshots contain cached runtime counters; a zero does not prove a counter was reported. Allocation preserves the collector’s reported value, and repeated GC increments are not lifetime totals.

Recent.Title: Observations behind the curves
Recent.Scope: Newest first · inspect exact values from this view
Recent.Empty: No retained observations in this view.

Details.Title: Runtime sample
Details.OpenFailed: The sample inspector could not be opened.
Details.Frozen: This sample stays fixed while the page and host continue to update. Values below preserve the recorded precision.
Details.CounterHelp: Counters may repeat across snapshots. Allocation is shown without interval rescaling; GC increments must not be summed as lifetime counts. Unreported counters can appear as zero.
